title: ks.runtime: 10-agent world spawn, isolation pinning, run_id default
outcome: Runtime runs the real world agents, fixes RunConfig.isolation before spawn and aborts on contradiction (findings 1, 4, 12)
acceptance: ks run --agents 10 spawns the ADR-06 agents; cross-uid ptrace from agent i to agent j and to the witness is EPERM (dumpable set after exec)
/proc readback contradicting RunConfig.isolation aborts before tick 0 (test with forced shared uid)
Default run_id = <scenario>-s<seed>; two same-seed repro runs stay byte-identical; an existing /run/ks/<run_id> refuses to start
